svg.title: Campanian Ignimbrite findspots and archaeological caves
svg.text: Where the Campanian Ignimbrite was found, and which caves have archaeology
geolod:CIFindspot by the certainty of its position, geolod:CIArchaeologicalSite ringed, geolod:ArchaeologicalCaveSite as diamonds.
74 findspots; the fill is the geolod:hasCertaintyLevel of the geometry node, so the certainty belongs to the position, not to the place.
13 of the 37 archaeological caves lie in this window; the others lie outside it.
